issue: Does First Step Act § 403(a) apply at resentencing after vacatur of an original sentence, where the Act was enacted after the original sentencing but before resentencing?

sides.position: First Step Act § 403(a) applies at resentencing following vacatur where the Act was enacted after the original sentencing but before resentencing (position as described in Eldridge n.17 as one side of a noted circuit split; the excerpts do not state the holding)
cases: United States v. Eldridge, 2 F.4th 27 (2d Cir. 2021)
United States v. Barrett, 102 F.4th 60 (2d Cir. 2024)

sides.position: First Step Act § 403(a) does not apply at such resentencing (the opposing side of the split as referenced in Eldridge n.17; the excerpts do not state the holding)
cases: United States v. Eldridge, 2 F.4th 27 (2d Cir. 2021)
United States v. Barrett, 102 F.4th 60 (2d Cir. 2024)

quote: we do not address that question on which this court has yet to rule conclusively, see United States v. Eldridge, 2 F.4th 27, 41 n.17 (2d Cir. 2021)
cite: United States v. Barrett, 102 F.4th 60 (2d Cir. 2024)
